user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your Luxor controller's Wi-Fi/LAN module.

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.50. Give the controller a DHCP reservation so it keeps this address.

reconfigure.description: Update the address of your Luxor controller.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Luxor controller at that address.

abort.already_configured: This controller is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the discovered controller.
abort.wrong_controller: That address belongs to a different Luxor controller.

data_description.color_groups: Selected groups get full color control. Each one is given its own color slot on the controller (group 1 uses slot 250, group 2 slot 249, and so on) so changing one group's color doesn't change others.

create_theme.name: Create theme
create_theme.description: Creates a new theme on the controller.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: Which Luxor controller to use. Only needed if you have more than one.

letter.name: Letter
letter.description: Facepack slot A–Z. Leave empty to use the first free one.

groups.name: Groups
groups.description: List of group lights and their brightness, e.g. [{"entity_id": "light.stair_light", "brightness_pct": 40}]. Groups not listed are left alone when the theme turns on.

save_current_as_theme.name: Save current lights as theme
save_current_as_theme.description: Saves every group's current brightness (and color) into a theme. Give a theme switch to overwrite it, or a name to create a new one.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: Which Luxor controller to use. Only needed if you have more than one.

name.name: New theme name
name.description: Create a new theme with this name instead.

letter.name: Letter
letter.description: Facepack slot A–Z. Leave empty to use the first free one.

lights.name: Only these groups
lights.description: Limit the snapshot to these group lights. Default: all groups, including ones that are off.

update_theme.name: Update theme
update_theme.description: Replaces the groups and brightness levels in a theme.

groups.name: Groups
groups.description: List of group lights and their brightness, e.g. [{"entity_id": "light.stair_light", "brightness_pct": 40}]. Groups not listed are left alone when the theme turns on.

rename_theme.name: Rename theme
rename_theme.description: Renames a theme. Its entity ID stays the same.

delete_theme.name: Delete theme
delete_theme.description: Deletes a theme from the controller and removes its switch.
